frontierchallenge.judge_shape_incident: ~40% of first-pass trials came back 'judge response lacks criterion_scores array'; the FC_DIAG stderr patch showed gpt-5.6-sol returning criterion_scores as {id: {...}} (complete content, wrong container shape). FC_NORM (shape normalization, 63/69 grader variants) + 5 judge attempts per repetition were applied from the rerun rounds on; all pruned trials then graded. Scores from the first pass and the rerun rounds are therefore not judged under byte-identical wrapper code, but the normalization changes only the parsed container shape, never scores or ids.
